newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello sees jobless rate below 8 pct mid-98.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello sees jobless rate below 8 pct mid-98.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday that he saw the unemployment rate at or a little below eight percent by the end of June 1998.

"I expect that by the end of the financial year we'll see it around or a little below the eight percent mark," Costello told reporters after a cabinet meeting to discuss Australia's unemployment rate.
"A number of indicators are showing that opportunities are increasing and its very much part of our policy to get better employment outcomes by the end of the year," he said.
The government forecast in its May budget that the unemployment rate would be 8.0 percent by the June quarter of 1998. The seasonally adjusted unemployment rate in June was 8.5 percent.

Many economists say the government's forecast of an unemployment rate below eight percent is optimistic as the jobless rate has been stuck at or above 8.5 percent for the past year. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
